description: Camera matrices for two illuminants per camera (XYZ to camera, row by row, as in the DNG tags ColorMatrix1 and ColorMatrix2 with their CalibrationIlluminant codes). FerrumPix interpolates between them for the white balance of each picture and adapts the as shot white to D65 with Bradford, as the DNG specification describes. Keys are LibRaw's normalized make and model. Generated by Diagnostics/Farbmatrix/zweimatrizen.py from the DNG Converter output of one raw file per camera; source names that file.
